column1: # Final Chromium gate for the printed text-pad change, run 2026-11-24 after the source freeze.

# Sources: CellText.fs 7bf6858c..., Paint.fs d1414458..., XlsxReader.fs ce94d44a..., tests/print/helpers.fsx 9bc25657..., tests/office-formats/xlsx-reader.fsx 10cd3c4a..., docs/excel-parity-tracker.md 52560827... .
# Dist: /var/tmp/textpad-dist (one Fable build from the frozen tree). Native: tools/spreadsheet-pdf-runner from the same tree.

# Harness: node tools/xlsx-browser/browser-textpad-proof.mjs (real Chromium, grid.ExportPdf {what:"sheet"}), measured with tools/excel-parity/measure-print-textpad.py against fresh direct Excel 2019 PDFs.
# Browser and native PDFs are identical to 0.00000 pt in every text and numeric word box; this table therefore also describes the native path.

# Note: the only numeric misses are F09 standard accounting fill-layout cells (the "$" word and the number share a run whose fill expansion differs from Excel). They are identical before/after the change and identical Chromium/native, are outside this change's text-section scope, and were excluded by the preregistered numeric prediction as "F09 keeps its fill layout". All other numeric controls are within the ordinary 0.6-0.7 pt page/font delta.
